messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | ESG, External Affairs & Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Talent At Team,

Your published info address rejected my earlier message, so I am using your current sales contact to ensure this executive introduction reaches the appropriate team.

I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, external affairs, executive advisory and strategic stakeholder engagement. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority relocation market. I am open to senior leadership mandates across ESG, government relations, external affairs, strategic partnerships, responsible business and country operations.

Executive profile: https://ragunauthramsaroop.com

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
